sentences.text: 2.  The aforementioned FIR was registered on the basis of the complaint submitted by the complainant Karanjit Singh alleging that his brother Gurwinder Singh was interested in settling abroad.

IIn n the year 2022, he came into contact with the accused Manjinder Singh who is an immigration agent, his father Dilbagh Singh and one Premjit Singh, Singh who assured that they could send his brother abroad and demanded a sum of Rs.40 lakhs for this purpose.

An 1 of 5 amount of Rs.7,70,000/-
Rs.7,70,000/ was paid to the accused Manjinder Singh and an amount of Rs.2,30,000/-
Rs.2,30,000/ was paid in cash to Dilbagh Singh Singh, father of Manjinder Singh.
Instead of sending his brother to USA as agreed, they had sent his brother to Russia and then to Poland Poland where he had been detained and by paying another sum of Rs.52,000/-

sentences.text: The accused Manjinder Singh instead of returning his money, assured that he would try again to send his brother abroad.

On that premise, he took another amount of Rs.22,55,000/
Rs.22,55,000/- from the complainant and then sent his brother to Dubai instead of USA.
By alleging that he had been cheated by Manjinder Singh and the co co-accused Dilbagh Singh and Premjit emjit Singh, he prayed for taking action in the matter.
3. On receipt of the complaint, an inquiry was conducted.

It was revealed that the present petitioner was also working as an agent with co co-- accused Manjinder Singh and an amount of Rs.3 lakh lakhs had been n got deposited from the complainant in the bank account of the wife of the present petitioner and another amount of Rs.2,70,000/-
Rs.2,70,000/ was deposited in the bank account of petitioner.
His wife Hardeep Kaur and himself were nominated as additional accused.

Apprehending prehending his arrest, the petitioner moved an application for grant of anticipatory bail which had been dismissed by the Court of Learned Additional Sessions Judge, Gurdaspur vide order dated 02.09.2025.
4.
It is argued by learned counsel for the petitio petitioner ner
that he has been falsely implicated in this case.
He was not named in the FIR and therefore is no allegation that he had induced the complainant to part money from him.
The 2 of 5 ingredients of offence of cheating are not attracted against him at all.

In fact, he is also one of the victim in this case since he had also given money to the accused Manjinder Singh for the purpose of sending him abroad but the said accused had failed to arrange any visa for him.
On his asking, accused Manjinder Singh had returned returned part of the money given by him, by transferring the same in the bank account of his wife and himself.
It was only at a later stage the petitioner came to know that the said amount of money so transferred was from the bank account of the complainant.
It is also argued that the petitioner has already given a detailed representation to SSP, Kapurthala for initiating action against the co-accused.
co His custodial interrogation is as such not required.
No recovery is to be affected from him.
He is ready to join investigation.
It is, therefore, argued that the petition deserves to be allowed.
5. Per contra, learned State counsel assisted by learned counsel for the complainant has argued that the allegations against the petitioner are quite serious in nature.
ure. His active complicity in the crime stands prima facie established.
For the purpose of conducting proper investigation in the matter matter,, his custodial interrogation is must.
No exceptional or extra extra-ordinary ordinary circumstance for grant of pre-arrest pre bail is made out.

It is,
therefore, argued that the petition does not deserve to be allowed.
6. This Court has heard the rival submi submissions ssions made by both the parties at considerable length.

sentences.text: The petitioner in connivance with the co co-accused accused is alleged to have cheated the complainant of an amount of Rs.5,70,000/ Rs.5,70,000/- by getting the same transferred in his as well as his wife bank account from the complainant on the pretext of arranging the visa for the brother of the complainant then duping him of the aforementioned amount of money.

Though, the petitioner has placed on record a copy of complaint (Annexure P-2) P 2) shown to have been given to SSP Kapurthala on 24.08.2024 for the purpose of taking action against co-accused accused Manjinder Singh.
However, the authenticity of the contents of these allegations as well as this complaint is yet to be looked into and hence cannot be taken into consideration at this stage.

The allegations prima facie reveal the factu factumm of involvement of the petitioner in the commission of the subject offences since an amount of Rs.5,70,000/-
Rs.5,70,000/ was transferred from the bank account of the complainant to the bank account of the petitioner as well as his wife.
8. The allegations against the petitioner are serious in nature.
The case is at its nascent stage.

It is well settled that anticipatory bail to an accused can be granted in exceptional circumstances only as a person couched in comparative safety of pre-arrest pre arrest bail would certainly nnot ot disclose all the facts within his knowledge.
In case custodial interrogation of the petitioner is denied to the Investigating Agency, that shall leave many glaring loopholes and gaps, thereby adversely effecting the investigation.
The Court is also requ required ired to see that an order of anticipatory bail does not operate as inroad in the normal legal procedure of criminal cases by the trial Court.

It is well settled proposition of law that the powers for grant of pre-arrest pre arrest bail are to be exercised by the Cour Courtt 4 of 5 in extra-ordinary ordinary and exceptional circumstances and with great caution while taking into consideration the nature of the accusation and the sentence which the conviction may entail.
In the instant case, no such exceptional or extra extra-ordinary ordinary circumstance is, however, made out from the pleas as taken by the petitioner.
For the purpose of conducting thorough and proper investigation custodial interrogation of the petitioner is must.
Taking into consideration the above discussed facts, this Court is of the considered considered opinion that the pet petition ition deserves to be dismissed.
According the same is dismissed.

9. It is made clear that any observation made herein above is only for the purpose of deciding the present petition and the same shall have no bearing on the merits erits of the case.
10.
Since the main petition has been dismissed, pending application, if any, is rendered infructuous.
(MANISHA BATRA) JUDGE 06.03.2026 Whether speaking/reasoned:- Yes/No Amit Sharma
